primitives.name: CompositionalProcess
primitives.statement: There is a process set with partial composition.
primitives.operational_definition: A carrier set P with a partially defined binary operation.

primitives.name: ProcessEquivalence
primitives.statement: There is an equivalence relation on processes.
primitives.operational_definition: A reflexive, symmetric, transitive relation on P.

definitions.name: CompositionCongruence
definitions.statement: Equivalent representatives compose to equivalent results whenever the compared compositions are defined.

definitions.name: QuotientProjection
definitions.statement: Map each process to its equivalence class.

claims.statement: Composition congruence is sufficient for representative-independent quotient composition.
Representative-independent quotient composition implies composition compatibility.
For a composition congruence, the quotient projection preserves composition.
Arbitrary non-congruence coarse-graining can destroy well-defined process composition.
Useful effective physical descriptions can be modeled as quotients preserving a selected family of operations and observables.

observables.name: QuotientClass
observables.definition: Equivalence class of a process under the selected coarse-graining relation.

falsifiers.condition: Give a composition congruence for which quotient composition depends on representatives.
Give a representative-independent quotient composition where the underlying equivalence is not compatible with composition.

metadata.purpose: Formalize structure-preserving coarse-graining as quotient by composition congruence.
